import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_FANOUT_XLSX_JOIN_002.json').read_text())['goal']
out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
acts=out.get('controller_actions') or []
caps=[(a.get('args') or {}).get('capability_id') for a in acts if a.get('type')=='invoke_capability']
assert any(a.get('type')=='invoke_capability_fanout' for a in acts),acts
assert 'xlsx.table.create_from_json_records' in caps,caps
assert 'xlsx.table.verify_against_json_records' in caps,caps
assert any(a.get('type')=='assert_runtime_fanout_decodes' for a in acts),acts
parts=out.get('compiled_parts') or []
assert any(p.get('selected_capability')=='xlsx.table.create_from_json_records' for p in parts),parts
assert any(p.get('selected_capability')=='xlsx.table.verify_against_json_records' for p in parts),parts
print(json.dumps({'compiler_mode':out.get('compiler_mode'),'action_types':[a.get('type') for a in acts],'capabilities':caps},sort_keys=True))
print('FANOUT_XLSX_COMPILER_COMPLETE')
PY
